methodology: Empirical quantile classification of predicted annual pure premium on French MTPL portfolio

tiers.name: Low
tiers.description: Favorable risk profile; low frequency and clean bonus-malus rating.

tiers.name: Moderate
tiers.description: Standard market risk profile; typical claim frequency and vehicle characteristics.

tiers.name: High
tiers.description: Elevated risk profile; higher claim likelihood due to dense urban environment, youthful driver, or malus.

tiers.name: Very High
tiers.description: Substantially heightened risk; high frequency exposure, significant malus, or adverse vehicle power.
